reason_for_new_identity: R36/F3 YF3-C1 original hypothesis required a permutation of an existing sensor schedule; the development-positive implementation changed the physical sensor set, so original F3 method fidelity was rejected.
distinct_hypothesis: A development-trained ten-scalar nonoracle physical-sensor SET reallocation (not merely a permutation) can improve detection and pre-detection matching accuracy under previously unseen transpositions while preserving a native matching baseline, budget, and steady-state correctness.

arms.mechanism: Exact pinned Y070 ten-read baseline, generalized public-only decoder matched across arms
Learn addresses to sample among public sensor locations using only development data, freeze address-selection algorithm and parameter values before sealed evaluation
Use the exact candidate sampled sensor-set and number of reads but match a fixed/alternative preregistered order to isolate read ordering from sensor identity

prospective_primary_metric: Onset-regime pre-detection mismatch count vs F4-CONTROL per disjoint novel transposition pair

prospective_falsification.strong: Both novel transposition pairs must show strictly fewer pre-detection mismatches vs control; steady-state remains zero mismatches; no extra reads, retained capacity, or illegal assignments
prospective_falsification.negative: A failed criterion is a valid scientific negative; never move onset, sensor schedule, cohort, or score threshold in response to sealed results
